sources.title: myMediWhisper: Construction of Burmese Medical Speech Corpus and ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Although Whisper models benefit from large-scale multilingual pre-training, their performance on Burmese medical speech remains limited. This work presents a Burmese medical speech recognition framework built on a high-quality 28-hour corpus recorded and validated by native speakers.
